Name: Brook of the Willows
Description: A brook in Moab named in Isaiah's lament, over which the abundance the Moabites had gained is carried away. Its exact course is debated, and it is sometimes identified with the brook Zered, but that identification is not certain, so it is kept as its own entry.
BiblicalSignificance: The brook of the willows is where Moab's wealth is carried away in Isaiah's lament.
